text: For the card, the limit of the two earlier watches lifted: on the person's word to this session ('copy the 0003 bundle outside the repo and open a session there') the bundle of meta_agent/builds/echo/0003 was copied, its untracked cache folders left out, to a scratch folder outside the repository with no CLAUDE.md, .claude or git repository in any folder above it; the copy's hash equalled the build card's bundle_sha256 before the run. This is a test copy and not a hand-over: no landed_at was written and the build is untouched (its hash still equals its card). A fresh session, claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort medium, was opened in the copy with a brief that named tasks/001-start.md and replay/rp-001.json and allowed it to write what the bundle's own instructions allow. What it reported, and what this seat read off the copy afterwards: the only instruction file in its context was the bundle's CLAUDE.md, and the bundle's three session skills were listed to it (beside the application's own, which are no part of the bundle); it loaded run-skill before the call and used its sections on finding a skill, on a tool no library skill calls and on what a session may change; the three commands printed 'gate: self-check ok', 'replay: 2 item(s), 2 as expected, 0 not; OK' and 'gates: interface pass, scientific undecided; overall undecided', the last with a failure status the task had told it to expect; the call of rp-001 through src/run_tool.py returned the message and its length as the item expects. Against the build, the copy has one file added, runs/rp-001-input.json (the input it wrote for the runner, which run-skill allows), none removed and none changed; failures.jsonl is empty. It said the folder was enough with nobody to ask, and named nothing in the bundle's text as unclear; its one stumble was its own, a command typed as one quoted string. What stays unshown: echo has no library skill, so src/run_skill.py and a library page were not exercised by a session; a bundle with library skills (the fixture rheometer's) has not been rebuilt from v4 or watched.
